title: Recursion
description:
Write each of these as a **recursive** function (it calls itself):

| Function | Result |
|---|---|
| `fact(n)` | n! for n from 0 to 20 |
| `fib(n)` | the nth Fibonacci number: fib(0) = 0, fib(1) = 1, fib(n) = fib(n−1) + fib(n−2); n up to 25 |
| `power(b, e)` | b to the power e by squaring: if e is 0, 1; if e is even, power(b, e/2) squared; if odd, b × power(b, e−1) |
| `digit_sum(n)` | the sum of the decimal digits of n >= 0: digit_sum(n / 10) + n mod 10, and 0 for 0 |

starter.solution.asm:
fact:
        mov     eax, 1
        ret

fib:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

power:
        mov     eax, 1
        ret

digit_sum:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
fact:
        cmp     rdi, 1
        jg      .recurse
        mov     eax, 1
        ret
.recurse:
        push    rbx
        mov     rbx, rdi
        lea     rdi, [rdi - 1]
        call    fact
        imul    rax, rbx
        pop     rbx
        ret

fib:
        cmp     rdi, 1
        jg      .recurse
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret
.recurse:
        push    rbx
        push    r12
        sub     rsp, 8
        mov     rbx, rdi
        lea     rdi, [rbx - 1]
        call    fib
        mov     r12, rax
        lea     rdi, [rbx - 2]
        call    fib
        add     rax, r12
        add     rsp, 8
        pop     r12
        pop     rbx
        ret

power:
        test    rsi, rsi
        jnz     .recurse
        mov     eax, 1
        ret
.recurse:
        push    rbx
        mov     rbx, rdi                ; b
        test    rsi, 1
        jnz     .odd
        shr     rsi, 1                  ; e / 2
        call    power
        imul    rax, rax
        pop     rbx
        ret
.odd:   dec     rsi
        call    power
        imul    rax, rbx
        pop     rbx
        ret

digit_sum:
        test    rdi, rdi
        jnz     .recurse
        xor     eax, eax
        ret
.recurse:
        push    rbx
        mov     rax, rdi
        xor     edx, edx
        mov     ecx, 10
        div     rcx                     ; rax = n / 10, rdx = the last digit
        mov     rbx, rdx
        mov     rdi, rax
        call    digit_sum
        add     rax, rbx
        pop     rbx
        ret
